results.content:
Based on 41 reviews

Review Base44?

Reviewers mostly praise Base44 for speed and ease: they say it can turn prompts into working apps, dashboards, landing pages, and prototypes quickly, with built-in auth, database, hosting, and useful API integrations. Several nontechnical users say it helps them ship real tools fast, while the makers of MindPal and Sequence report using it for full-stack apps, pages, and internal tools. The main complaints are inconsistent output, thin documentation, weak support, aggressive credit pricing, vendor lock-in, and a few trust-damaging UX traps.
